seoDescription: Lewisville ISD starts Aug. 12, 2026 and ends May 21, 2027. Find breaks, early-release times, school hours, the official PDF, and an .ics calendar file.
heroSummary: LISD divides 174 instructional days into an 84-day first semester and a 90-day second semester. December 18 and May 21 are early releases, and March 29 is reserved as the district's Bad Weather Day.
calendarNotes: The official LISD calendar lists 174 instructional days: 84 in the first semester and 90 in the second. December 18 and May 21 are early-release dates; dismissal times are listed in the school-hours section. January 4 is a staff day before students return January 5. March 29 is the district's bad weather day and should be rechecked if LISD uses weather make-up time earlier in the year.

customSections.label: What LISD Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few dates on the LISD calendar are easy to overlook:

groups.label: Important calendar notes
items: December 18: Students and staff have early release.
January 4–5: January 4 is a staff day; students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5.
March 29: LISD marks this as its bad weather day. Check the district calendar again if weather closures occur earlier in the year.
May 21: The last day of school is also an early-release day, so plan pickup or afternoon care around the shortened day.

customSections.label: About Lewisville ISD
customSections.content: Lewisville ISD serves communities across southern Denton County, including Lewisville, Flower Mound, Highland Village, and The Colony. Districtwide academic dates generally apply across LISD, while testing, athletics, performances, graduation, and other campus events may follow individual school calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Lewisville ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Lewisville ISD starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the LISD early release dates?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists December 18, 2026 and May 21, 2027 as early-release dates. High schools dismiss at 1:00 p.m., middle schools at 12:20 p.m., and elementary schools at 11:45 a.m. Half-day Pre-K and early childhood schedules differ.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Lewisville ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. January 4 is a staff day with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Lewisville ISD 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The Lewisville ISD 2026–27 academic calendar lists 174 instructional days: 84 days in the first semester and 90 days in the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the LISD bad weather day?
calendarFaqs.a: LISD marks Monday, March 29, 2027 as its bad weather day. Check the official district calendar again if weather closures occur earlier in the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the MySchoolDates calendar update automatically if LISD changes a date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Check the official LISD calendar page and campus announcements for later revisions or emergency schedule changes.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: Three changes families are most likely to notice.
content: Spring Break moves from March 16–20 in 2025–26 to March 15–19 in 2026–27.
The last student day moves from May 22 in 2025–26 to May 21 in 2026–27.
